description: issue #689 (checker parity with the runtime's isPrimitiveName guard #403): `define beep ... end` redefines `beep`, a Sound primitive (spec/interaction-events.md). The static checker flags the procedure name at its own span. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes the primitives of every optional profile built-in names UNCONDITIONALLY -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- so a conforming implementation raises here with or without `sound` claimed. `sound-arity.test.mjs` asserts both directions alike -- with `sound` claimed and without.
